CALLER: Wait, am I talking to a robot?

AGENT: I've booked your son for a same-day triage with Dr. Patel today at 1:00 PM. Please come in as soon as you can. I'll also text you the address and any forms you need to fill out. 

Is there anything else I can help you with?
